notes.content:

notes.title: 2.5.2020 Heckinbear Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34830775/092d0b91c423eaa6736e4ae57d7e2a7be1a4372d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34830775/21eb12ed207331f626c5d5878fb8d7b1dfc0ba27.png[/img][/url]
Hello!
Today I have released an update featuring some bugfixes and quite a few new pieces of art! 
As you travel throughout the world of Obscure Doubt, you may notice something that looks like a piece of art on the wall. If you move to inspect it, you may notice an amazing piece of art of a character, done by the amazing Heckinbear!

If you would like to check out more of her stuff, you can find her on Twitter under @heckinbear.

Thank you! :D


If you happen to spot any bugs, please don't hesitate to let me know at caleb.ball@disbandedcrow.com.

notes.title: 11.18.19 - The Tall Boi Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in my game! I am excited to show off the biggest update yet, which I call the Tall Boi update! 

I have gone through and painstakingly stretched out most character sprites to make the game feel a tiny bit less "RPG Maker-y" and a tiny bit more unique. You should also see a new icon and may notice a bit more art and easter eggs. 

I hope you enjoy, and thank you again! :D
